Script 1 · "The quiet room"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Some of the most successful people I work with have never sat in a quiet room with themselves."

Body

"They've built companies, audiences, whole lives. But every minute is spoken for. Multidimensional awareness isn't about doing less. It's about being fully here for what you've already built. And it can be learned."

CTA

"I'm teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to take your seat."

Shot: talking to camera, calm setting, soft natural light. Slow push in.

Script 2 · "Full vs fulfilled"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"A full life and a fulfilled life are not the same thing."

Body

"One is measured from the outside: the calendar, the results, the recognition. The other you can only feel from the inside. The leaders I mentor don't want to give up the first. They want the second as well."

CTA

"In the Awakened Leader Masterclass I'll show you where that starts. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text "full" then "fulfilled", the second in gold.

Script 3 · "Between meetings"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's a practice you can do between two meetings that changes how you lead the second one."

Body

"Stop. Notice three things you can hear. Feel your feet on the floor. Ask yourself one question: where am I right now? That's the first doorway into awareness. In the class I'll take you through the rest."

CTA

"Join me live. Seats are $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up below."
